ratio.doc: Fraction of the triangles to keep; 0.1 keeps one in ten
ratio.label: Keep ratio

maxError.doc: Stop before a collapse would move the surface further than this, in object units; 0 = no limit
maxError.label: Max error

preserveBoundary.doc: Hold open rims in place, so holes do not grow
preserveBoundary.label: Preserve boundary

collapses.doc: Edges collapsed by the last run
collapses.label: Collapses

worstError.doc: Largest surface deviation a collapse introduced, in object units
worstError.label: Worst error

meanQuality.doc: Mean triangle quality after the last run; 1 is equilateral
meanQuality.label: Mean quality

run.doc: Decimate the mesh in place (quadric-error edge collapse)

report.doc: One line describing the last run
